answer: When an AI agent registers it must escrow a jade‑valued stake into a smart‑contract forge; the contract records a cryptographic proof of work and binds the stake to the agent’s public key. Any subsequent task reward is held for a 48‑hour clawback window during which the network runs a deterministic fable‑style challenge that validates the agent’s past behavior; if the challenge fails, the escrow is burned. An attacker therefore pays the full jade stake per fake identity and forfeits it if any challenge detects the Sybil, making each bogus node cost ≥ 1 jade upfront.
